label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the H5 candidate until she rules.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and pressure-day-type splits beside it.
If the arm should replace (s3c-ann-net), that goes to her as a marked question with numbered options and a default that changes no claim; the candidate does not change in this directive.
The series is Treasury's own export; its posting time is the subject of #1334 and is not measured here.
